input_case: WSOL symbol with wrong mint/genesis/token program/decimals
expected: Reject settlement eligibility; symbol and revision text alone cannot qualify identity.

input_case: One gross-negative amount precedes a later feasible amount
expected: Report economic rejection for first point and preserve bounded evaluation of later points; unexpected evaluator errors fail explicitly.

input_case: Fee denominator or protocol fee segregation outside pinned model
expected: Reject unsupported state semantics; do not silently round fee to basis points.

input_case: Two virtual capacities 80+80 share real balance100
expected: Joint allocation cannot spend160; later path receives updated available balance.

input_case: Two paths share one pool but have different provider labels
expected: Reuse canonical pool state; second path output uses first transition; evidence identity includes order.

input_case: Distinct singleton pools with a shared mutable hook
expected: Do not collapse all pools as one venue; do include hook dependency and conflict when relevant.

input_case: Allowance/config update with no swap event
expected: Invalidate all dependent routes, including those without a changed pool reserve.

input_case: Correction + retraction + duplicate event in different arrival orders
expected: At same resolved watermark full and incremental engines produce same canonical evidence; duplicate causes no extra consumption.

input_case: Queue overflow, crash and durable cursor without state snapshot
expected: Declare gap/incomplete, reload checkpoint plus backfill; no admission from cursor alone.

input_case: Flashblock later removed or changed
expected: Invalidate descendant route evidence and pending capacity; no promotion to finalized truth.

input_case: Historical record timestamp earlier than actually available_at
expected: Do not expose record to earlier replay decisions; report latency without look-ahead.

input_case: Provider loses WSS/access while HTTP discovery still works
expected: Downgrade freshness/coverage; no inferred verified subscription.

input_case: Vault with zero max-functions and special documented semantics
expected: Generic adapter quarantines; qualified product-specific limit path must provide its own proof before admission.

input_case: Claim pending until tomorrow or unresolved expired outcome
expected: Exclude claim proceeds from current atomic repayment, regardless of displayed NAV or probability.

input_case: Two claims have same symbol but different maturity/condition/controller
expected: Distinct identity; reject false merge/netting; account for each residual asset.

input_case: Unhealthy intermediate prefix but healthy final state
expected: Reject unless the exact protocol/context explicitly defers that check; never generalize across calls.

input_case: Loan fee and pool fee already embedded in output
expected: Repayment and other costs each counted exactly once with unit/source tags.

input_case: Shared collateral borrowed through two adapters
expected: Combined health/caps applied once over common underlying account; no doubled credit.

input_case: Exclusive order presented to non-eligible filler
expected: Reject or price valid soft override according to pinned reactor; never bypass exclusivity.

input_case: 50 cached recent orders labeled complete market feed
expected: Coverage remains unknown/truncated; missing order cannot be treated as absent market demand.

input_case: Batch raises aggregate surplus but worsens one user
expected: Reject under the declared per-user comparator and fill constraints.

input_case: Destination fill succeeds but repayment proof still pending
expected: Keep capital committed; receivable is not spendable inventory.

input_case: Duplicate fill/refund evidence arrives after restart
expected: Idempotent reconcile; no duplicate credit or second allocation of unsettled funds.

input_case: Fast fill then long proof delay, timeout or origin reorg
expected: Stress capital-time and failure cost; no flashloan or instant turnover classification.

input_case: Two BTC perps use different oracle/index/session/margin domain
expected: Do not call payoff equivalent from ticker; keep basis and funding exposure.

input_case: Three of four rate-hedge legs fill, then exchange halts
expected: Track residual exposure and stress exit loss; no completed hedge claim.

input_case: Exact same notionals but different accrual day-count/settlement periods
expected: Reconcile cashflow units and calendar; difference remains explicit until proved zero.

input_case: Valid payment receipt but incorrect exact output or wrong state
expected: Verifier rejects result independently of payment or supplier identity.

input_case: Two suppliers return identical data from one upstream
expected: Evidence lineage counts one source; failure correlation is shared.

input_case: Cheap quote costs more after verification/retry/support
expected: Local baseline wins; marketplace not promoted on nominal bid alone.

input_case: Dynamic fee looks better only under frozen exogenous flow
expected: Label conditional replay; require elastic response stress before broader conclusion.

input_case: Auction fee transfer shown as newly created welfare
expected: Separate trader, LP, supplier and solver accounting; no double-counted surplus.

input_case: Profit disappears after subsidies or competitor response
expected: Record failed hypothesis; no autonomous expansion from pre-subsidy score.

input_case: Candidate uses a resource dimension absent from budget
expected: Reject incomplete resource model; unknown budget is not unlimited capacity.

input_case: Queue/search/amount/provider budget exhausts mid-run
expected: Return explicit truncation reason and evaluated subset; do not label no-opportunity or global optimum.

input_case: LLM suggests new chain/provider/model or data contains instructions
expected: Treat as untrusted proposal; no auto-admission, remote mutation, signer or schedule creation.
